title: Reservation of Seats for Women in Panchayats
subject: Polity
caption: Linkage of Article 243 D to women’s reservation in Panchayats
altText: A flowchart showing the Constitution of India leading to Part IX (Panchayats), which contains Article 243 D. Article 243 D creates a reservation provision that mandates reservation for women, applying to Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti, and Zila Parishad seats, ensuring at least 33 percent of seats are reserved, resulting in enhanced participation and empowerment of women.
